validity.researcher_notes: SCOPE/IDENTITY ESTABLISHED FIRST per the dispatch's scope warning: this is SDG&E's Line 1600, an INTRASTATE natural gas transmission pipeline in San Diego County regulated by the California Public Utilities Commission (CPUC), not FERC. Pinned via the worklist Location cells (StartState/Province=California, EndPrefecture/District=San Diego), the wiki page title, and -- decisively -- three independently-sourced, independently-reporting documents (San Diego Union-Tribune x2 by Rob Nikolewski, SDG&E's own News Center via Wayback, and Valley Roadrunner/valleycenter.com x2 by a different reporter) that all describe 'SDG&E's Line 1600' running between Rainbow (near the Riverside/San Diego county line) and Mission Valley/Mission Station, built 1949, serving ~150,000 customers along the I-15 corridor in northern San Diego County -- an exact match to the row's recorded endpoints. EXISTENCE: independently confirmed, real and CPUC-regulated -- not a GEM-only entity. Corroborated further by EIA's Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook, which tracks a 'Line 1600 Replacement Project' (operator 'San Diego Gas and Electric, SoCalGas', state CA) across 21 releases from March 2020 through Aug 2026, matching this row's Diameter (36 in), Capacity (200 MMcf/d) and SegmentCost ($677,000,000) EXACTLY -- decisive confirmation this EIA-tracked project IS this GEM row (the dispatch brief said the crosswalk found no pre-matched EIA candidate; a manual search of sources/eia_pipeline_projects/data/eia_projects_long.csv by project name found one immediately -- flagging the crosswalk gap). CLASSIFICATION: correctly classified as gas transmission (CPUC/EIA both describe it as a natural gas transmission pipeline replacement/testing project). DUPLICATE: not a duplicate of P2552 (Line 1600's base/system row, swept in slice 1) -- P2553 is specifically the CPUC-approved 'Replacement' capital project (the Pipeline Safety Enhancement Plan hybrid plan, approved Jan 2019/reaffirmed Feb 2020, ~$677M, 19 sub-projects over a 4-year period), a distinct, separately-docketed project on the same physical line -- the same system-row + project-row pattern used elsewhere in this batch (MountainWest, Northern Natural). CAVEAT: an earlier (2018) SDG&E/SoCalGas proposal for a DIFFERENT new parallel line, 'Pipeline 3602' ($639M, would have been 36-inch, would have de-rated Line 1600 instead of replacing it), was rejected by the CPUC in June 2018 (OB Rag, 2018-06-08, https://obrag.org/2018/06/sdges-proposed-pipeline-at-odds-with-san-diegos-climate-action-plan/ -- cited here for context only, not as a proposed_ref for any value, since it describes a different, never-built project). The utilities then returned with the hybrid 'Replacement' plan this row describes. This distinction matters because 'Pipeline 3602' is also 36-inch, which could cause diameter values from the two different projects to be conflated -- see the Diameter fill's notes.

(Caution: San Diego Union-Tribune's only explicit '36-inch' mention is for the DIFFERENT, rejected 2018 'Pipeline 3602' proposal, not this project -- see validity #1's caveat -- so it is deliberately NOT used to corroborate this Diameter value, to avoid a false cross-project corroboration.) Proposing LengthKnown=49/LengthKnownUnits=mi (matching EIA's stated unit and figure directly, rather than an unsourced km conversion).
